proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11250 vadhū explicitly gives Maithili bahu wife and Hindi bahū bride/wife. The survey breathy-vowel bahṳ keeps the same segmental form and family; voice quality is preserved. Intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
